query:
SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES 
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() 
AND TABLE_NAME IN (
  'access_log_archives', 'access_logs', 'activities', 'activity_submissions',
  'assessment_answers', 'assessment_attempts', 'assessment_questions', 'assessments',
  'backup_schedules', 'backups', 'dashboard_preferences', 'email_campaigns', 'email_configs',
  'mistake_notebook_attempts', 'mistake_notebook_insights', 'mistake_notebook_questions',
  'mistake_notebook_study_plans', 'mistake_notebook_topics', 'notification_preferences',
  'push_notification_log', 'push_subscriptions', 'question_type_instructions',
  'system_settings', 'vps_alerts', 'vps_metrics', 'vps_servers'
)
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;
